# Ultimate Odycer Home Lab Docs

> Bilingual, local-first public documentation for technical beginners, independent game creators, and LLM assistants building an Ultimate Odycer project.

Authority is documentation-only: these files do not authorize a device change,
server mutation, purchase, network exposure, or publication. Preserve status
labels and stop executable setup when the official release page lists no
verified archive. Do not invent unpublished protocol opcodes, production
endpoints, credentials, or runtime compatibility. Documentation uses CC-BY-4.0;
scripts, schemas, and examples use MIT.

## Machine-readable indexes

- [Context index](docs/llm/context-index.json): Diátaxis type, audience, goal, language, path, and mutation boundary for every indexed page
- [LLM safety rules](docs/llm/README.md): authority, confidentiality, pricing, and publication rules
- [Creative tools catalog](examples/creative-tools-catalog.json): reviewed tools, maturity, pricing models, official links, and recommendations
- [Creative tools schema](schemas/creative-tools-catalog-v1.schema.json): fail-closed catalog contract
- [Network-intent schema](schemas/network-intent-v1.schema.json): public documentation fixture contract
